items.headline: Wind Advisory issued September 24 at 6:58AM AKDT until September 27 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 60 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Windy Pass.

* WHEN...From midnight tonight to 4 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds could blow around unsecured objects. Travel
could be difficult, especially for high profile vehicles.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds may decrease slightly Saturday afternoon
and evening before increasing briefly overnight into early Sunday.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 24 at 6:01AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:

as a front lifts north across the Gulf of Alaska. Timing of peak
winds will be late Friday morning through Friday night, then
gradually tapering Saturday. Winds through Turnagain Arm will bend
away from west Anchorage early Friday, but could bend into

items.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued September 24 at 5:33AM AKDT until September 26 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:

* WHERE...Kuskokwim Delta Coast including Kwigillingok and
Kipnuk.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Coastal flooding of low lying areas and erosion are
possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...There will be multiple peaks in water
levels for the Kuskokwi
items.areas: Kuskokwim Delta Coast and Nunivak Island
items.instruction:
A coastal flood warning means that flooding is occurring or
imminent. Coastal residents in the warned area should be alert
for rising water, and take appropriate action to protect life and
property.
